record.question: A Government servant attempts unsuccessfully to use outside influence for a service matter. Under Rule 20:
options: There is no violation unless influence is actually exercised
There is no violation unless the service benefit is actually obtained
There is no violation unless the outside person is political
The attempt itself is covered by the prohibition
